description: Reported bug: in the charge move stage the hint bar promises '[X] Snap to Contact' but X does nothing — only the on-screen Snap to Contact button works. Root cause: a real pad player has the VIRTUAL CURSOR live (the left stick is how you aim at a model for A = Grab Model), and with the cursor active VirtualCursor turned X into a synthetic right-click while PadRouter._context_action bailed on `VirtualCursor.is_cursor_active()` BEFORE its charge snap check. pad_charge_full_flow never moved the stick, so X routed through a parked cursor and the dead button never showed up. This scenario drives the stick first — the cursor ring is up when X is pressed — and asserts the snap still fires.

steps.comment: A toggles the first eligible target into the declaration
the bar makes the promise X has to keep
the player aims with the left stick — exactly what A = Grab Model needs — which raises the virtual cursor ring
the state a real pad player is in when they read '[X] Snap to Contact'
THE BUG: before the fix the cursor ate X as a synthetic right-click and this stayed non-zero
nothing left to snap, so the button greys out...
...and the bar stops promising X, instead of leaving a dead button for the last press of the stage
Start = Confirm Charge Moves — the snapped placement is a real, confirmable charge
a fresh unit at the declare stage — the OTHER thing the bar promises X in this phase
cursor still live from the stick nudge above
X = Skip Charge — dead the same way before the fix, since the cursor ate it
the skip fired instead of being swallowed as a right-click

steps.script:
var cc = tree.current_scene.charge_controller
var ids = []
for i in range(cc.unit_selector.item_count):
	ids.append(str(cc.unit_selector.get_item_metadata(i)))
return "U_BOYZ_E" in ids
steps.comment: and the phase really recorded it — the unit has left UNITS THAT CAN CHARGE
